[頌歌者]
聖誕快樂！
嘿！你！一想到聖誕節，你會想到什麼？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Jingle Bells! Jingle Bells! Jingle all the way!

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
O' what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleigh!
scripts.translation:

坐著單馬拉的敞篷雪橇，真是快樂呀！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

嘿，小夥子！說到聖誕節，你最先想到什麼？

scripts.text:

Merry Christmas!

you think about Christmas?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
聖誕快樂！
嘿，姑娘！說到聖誕節，你最先想到什麼？

scripts.text: Santa Claus
scripts.translation: 聖誕老人

scripts.text: Gift Boxes
scripts.translation: 禮物盒

scripts.text: Carols
scripts.translation: 頌歌

scripts.text: Santa Costumes
scripts.translation: 聖誕老人服裝

scripts.text: Fake Santa Antonio
scripts.translation: 假聖誕老人安東尼奧

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Santa Claus!
You're so innocent!!
Ah!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
聖誕老人！
你還真有童心啊！！
啊！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Here's a secret!
There's a rumor that Santa Claus lives in a certain village all throughout the year.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
告訴你一個秘密！
有傳言說，聖誕老人一年到頭都住在某個村莊裡。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
But now!!!
In this Christmas season!!
You guys can meet Santa on either of the five possible villages throughout Rune-Midgerts!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
不過現在！！！聖誕節期間！！
盧恩·米德加茲有五個村莊可能出現聖誕老人，去那裡就有機會見到他！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you win over Santa, you can get a gift. Would you go for it?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
贏過聖誕老人，就能得到禮物。
要去試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Isn't that big news?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
頌歌者的獨家新聞！哈！
這訊息夠大的吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Gift boxes?! All right!
Isn't it thrilling to open gifts over your head!!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
禮物盒？！不錯！
舉過頭頂開啟禮物，多讓人興奮啊！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Anyway, did you know...
Some villain, a fake Santa robbed some gifts from the good Santa!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
對了，你聽說了嗎...
有個假聖誕老人搶走了真正的聖誕老人準備的禮物！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Furthermore, he has put bad magic on the gifts so that they become monsters!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
而且，他在禮物上施了邪惡的魔法，讓它們變成了魔物！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Isn't it amazing?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
頌歌者的獨家新聞！哈！
是不是很驚人？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Ah, a music box is useful.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
啊，音樂盒很有用。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Though we can't all play it around the village as we planned, it's cool that you carry it.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
雖然不能按原計劃在村裡到處播放，但能隨身帶著音樂盒，也挺不錯的。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We want to enjoy carols all together... I hope to get Crystal Pieces!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
我們想和大家一起欣賞頌歌...真希望能找到水晶碎片！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的話，能把它們給我嗎？

scripts.text: Why not? Sure, I can give you some.
scripts.translation: 當然，給你一些

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Yes, please.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
好的，拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的話，能把它們給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Wow, you have them.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
哇，你居然有。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
I can bake you a cake, and I can carve your name on the cake, if you want!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
我可以給你烤個蛋糕，你願意的話，還能在上面寫上你的名字！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Please name it for me.
scripts.translation: 請寫上我的名字

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Thank for your help!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
謝謝你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Many people live in the giant world!
So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
世界這麼大，住著那麼多人！
許多人都想聽我唱頌歌，可我總是缺少水晶碎片。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的話，能把它們給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
在這個聖誕季，讓我們多關心身邊的人吧！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Oh!
Shyness!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
啊！
害羞了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Anyway, thanks a lot for your help.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
總之，非常感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Many people live in the giant world!
So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的話，能把它們給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
在這個聖誕季，讓我們多關心身邊的人吧！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You know about Christmas!
Talking about Christmas...
...it's carols!!!
I've been waiting for this for when
Christmas comes around!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
你懂聖誕節！
說到聖誕節...當然是頌歌！！！
我一直盼著聖誕節到來，好好唱個痛快！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
But there's been no caroling here and there like before, so we can't feel the Christmas spirit.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
可現在不像以前，到處都能聽到頌歌了，連聖誕氣氛都淡了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
So, I installed a Singing Crystal in Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
所以，我在普隆德拉安裝了一個歌唱水晶...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
but that jerk Antonio broke the crystal!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
但那個混蛋安東尼奧把水晶弄壞了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
The gift boxes have been changing into monsters since Antonio placed some magic on them, so the monsters ate up the crystal fragments!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
安東尼奧給禮物盒施了魔法，把它們變成魔物，那些魔物又把水晶碎片吃掉了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
I am so devastated, since the Singing Crystal has been the hope of many children around the villages.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
周圍村莊的許多孩子都盼著聽歌唱水晶呢，這讓我難過極了。

scripts.text: There's no other way to carol?
scripts.translation: 沒有其他辦法唱頌歌了嗎？

scripts.text: You can hear carols in Lutie.
scripts.translation: 薑餅城能聽到頌歌

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
And just stay there, every Christmas, for your whole life?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
那就每年聖誕節都待在那裡，一輩子都這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Oh, nevermind.
Ah...
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
哦，算了。
啊...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
給村莊做點唱機也許不容易，不過音樂盒應該能做出來。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
我們需要魔物吃掉的^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
帶來^0000FF6個歌唱水晶碎片^000000，我就送你禮物！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Sounds cool, huh!!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
聽起來很酷，對吧！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
...Why are you staring at me like that?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
...你為什麼那樣盯著我看？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You're thinking that we are always getting our plans spoiled, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
你是不是在想，我們的計劃怎麼總被人搞砸？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
I know that we are not good at controlling stuff, but our rewards are good, right?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
我知道我們不太會處理這些事，不過給的獎勵還不錯，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Hey, we treat you good...
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
嘿，我們對你很好的...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You are so cruel to me!
Bad! Bad!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
你也太無情了！
壞人！壞人！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Please, for our children's hope!!!?
Please bring me 6 Singing Crystal Pieces from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
拜託了，為了孩子們的希望！！！
請從^0000FF暴力禮物盒^000000身上收集6個歌唱水晶碎片帶來！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
They're definitely as harsh as their name.
Go on please!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
它們還真是名副其實的兇暴。
拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Santa costumes!!
You know, the santa costumes that the monsters are wearing now aren't genuine!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
聖誕老人服裝！！
你知道嗎，魔物現在穿的聖誕老人服裝不是正品！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
The rumor 'round here is, Lutie's designer made these costumes.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
聽說這些服裝是薑餅城的設計師做的。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Every year, adventurers challenge to attack Antonio the fake Santa, but there's no way to catch up to him due to his hat and costume!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
每年都有冒險者挑戰假聖誕老人安東尼奧，可他有那頂帽子和那身衣服，誰也追不上！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Are there some special abilities within them?
There's still the designer in the Christmas village... How about asking her to make that costume?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
難道帽子和衣服有什麼特殊能力？
那位設計師還在聖誕村呢...不如請她也做一套？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
It's hot, huh?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
頌歌者的獨家新聞！哈！
很勁爆，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
A-N-T-O-N-I-O!!!
As I heard, this Antonio is quite different from before.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
安-東-尼-奧！！！
我聽說，這個安東尼奧和以前很不一樣了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
He seems to be quite resolved with himself since he ran away from people before.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
以前他總是逃跑，現在似乎下了決心，不再像以前那樣了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
And he isn't alone anymore... is what I heard...
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
而且，他現在不是獨自行動了...聽說是這樣...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Hotness, right?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
頌歌者的獨家新聞！哈！
很勁爆，對吧？

scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
帶來^0000FF6個歌唱水晶碎片^000000，我就送你禮物！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
For all of the children of this world!!!
Please bring me ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
為了這世上所有的孩子！！！
請幫我收集^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000，去找那些^0000FF暴力禮物盒^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Be careful!
They're definitely as harsh as their name.
Take care!!!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
小心！它們還真是名副其實的兇暴。
多保重！！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Don't cry, don't cry!
Santa won't give you a gift if you're crying.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
別哭，別哭！
如果你哭了，聖誕老人就不會給你禮物了。

scripts.text: [Caroller]
scripts.translation: [頌歌者]

scripts.text: I got them!
scripts.translation: 我拿到了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Wow, you got them!
They are so cruel, aren't they?
I'm happy to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
哇，拿到了！
它們很兇吧？
真高興你平安回來了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Let's count together!
... ...
Six!!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
讓我們一起數一數！
... ...
六個！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
All right! We can start to make our music box with crystal fragments.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
好！這下能用水晶碎片做音樂盒了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We would amplify the sounds of the crystal fragments to sound through the music box.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
把水晶碎片的聲音放大，再通過音樂盒播放出來。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You know, a music box that sounds like a jukebox!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
也就是說，做個能像點唱機一樣播放音樂的音樂盒！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
It's handy. You can carry it, as well as listen to sweet carols anywhere.
Doesn't that sound cool!?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
它很方便。你可以隨身攜帶，隨時隨地聆聽甜美的頌歌。
聽起來很酷，不是嗎！？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
還需要一些材料。
^0000FF10個樹幹、1個高階鐵砧、1個朱畢雷、10個粘稠液體和3克拉鑽石^000000！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Those are all needed.
Isn't that easy?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
這些就是全部所需。
不難吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We can make a music box with Singing Crystal Pieces.
It's handy, you can hear carols anywhere. Sounds cool?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
用歌唱水晶碎片就能做音樂盒。
隨身帶著，走到哪裡都能聽頌歌，是不是很棒？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]

^0000FF10個樹幹、1個高階鐵砧、1個朱畢雷、10個粘稠液體和3克拉鑽石^000000！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
That's all we need.
Isn't that easy?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
這些就是全部所需。
不難吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
jingle all the way!
O what fun it is to ride, in a
one... horse... o-pen... sleigh!!!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
叮叮噹，叮叮噹，鈴兒響叮噹！
坐著...一匹馬拉的...敞篷...雪橇，真是快樂呀！！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Wow!
You came back!
Did you bring all the materials?
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
哇！
你回來了！
材料都帶齊了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Good!
No need to hesitate! Let's get started to make our music box.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
好！別猶豫了，開始做音樂盒吧。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Blacksmith hammers on trunk... and we shape the frame.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
用鐵匠的錘子敲打樹幹...把框架做出來。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Please use the Singing Crystal Pieces for a column, the Diamond as a prop, and the Sticky Mucus as glue.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
請使用歌唱水晶碎片作為支柱，鑽石作為支撐，粘稠液體作為膠水。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
And now...
we decorate with a Jubilee...
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
然後...用朱畢雷裝飾一下...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
The last step...!
Breating life into it!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
最後一步...！
賦予它生命！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
It's done now!!!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
完成了！！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
It's so cool! Isn't it cute!!?!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
太酷了！是不是很可愛！！？！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You did as I requested, so I will give you gifts, as promised.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
你幫我辦好了這件事，接下來該兌現承諾，送你禮物了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
One, is this music box.
Please play this music box all over the villages!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
第一份禮物，就是這個音樂盒。
帶著它到各個村莊播放吧！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Another present is a Christmas cake especially shaped like your name!
I made this cake shaped like your name!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
另一份禮物，是特意做成你名字形狀的聖誕蛋糕！
你看，形狀就是你的名字哦！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Don't worry, it tastes good.
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
別擔心，味道很好的。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Thanks a lot.
Merry Christmas!
Have a good holiday season!
scripts.translation:
[頌歌者]
非常感謝。
聖誕快樂！
假期愉快！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Wow! Were you naughty or nice this year?
All right, what comes to your mind when you think about Christmas?
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
哇！今年你是乖孩子，還是調皮的孩子呢？
說到聖誕節，你最先想到什麼？

scripts.text: Carolling
scripts.translation: 唱頌歌

scripts.text: Santa Claus
scripts.translation: 聖誕老人

scripts.text: Gift Boxes
scripts.translation: 禮物盒

scripts.text: Santa Costume
scripts.translation: 聖誕老人服裝

scripts.text: Not much really...
scripts.translation: 沒什麼特別的...

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Carolling! That's good!
A sweet carol always makes Christmas more happy!!!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
唱頌歌！不錯！
動聽的頌歌總能讓聖誕節更快樂！！！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Yes indeed Carolling spreads Joy throughout the world?
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
是啊，頌歌能把歡樂傳遍世界，對不對？

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Ho ho ho! What a good boy!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
Ho ho ho! 真是個乖男孩！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Ho ho ho! What a good girl!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
Ho ho ho! 真是個乖女孩！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
But you should be wary of a fake Santa romaing around.
Have you heard of Antonio, who invades villages every Christmas?
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
不過，要小心那個到處亂跑的假聖誕老人。
聽說過安東尼奧嗎？他每年聖誕節都會闖進村莊搗亂。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
He has stolen my gifts, as well as attacked adventurers around Toy and Lutie field.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
他偷走了我的禮物，還襲擊了玩具城和薑餅城野外附近的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
A bad Santa ruins us good Santa's reputations!
The World Santa Organization is considering this a grave situation.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
壞聖誕老人把我們這些好聖誕老人的名聲都毀了！
世界聖誕老人組織對這件事非常重視。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
A gift box! That sounds good!
It's so exciting to open gift boxes when you wake up on Christmas morning!!!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
禮物盒！不錯！
聖誕節早晨一醒來就能開啟禮物盒，多讓人興奮啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
But we have very little gifts now, since Santa Antonio has stolen my gift bag.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
可現在剩下的禮物不多了，安東尼奧偷走了我的禮物袋。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Many adventurers try to catch up to him, but he is not easy to catch.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
許多冒險者試圖追上他，但他並不容易抓住。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Anyway let those adventurers try to catch him, I have a small game for you.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
總之就讓那些冒險者去抓他吧，我有個小遊戲要和你玩。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I will give you a small gift if you beat me!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
如果你贏了我，我會給你一份小禮物！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Do you want to play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
你想和我玩個小遊戲嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes, I would.
scripts.translation: 好，我來玩

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Aww, don't be afraid.
If you've been a little naughty this year I won't stuff your stockings with coal.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
哎呀，別害怕。
如果你今年有點淘氣，我也不會往你的襪子裡塞煤塊。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I will stay here throughout the Christmas season, just visit me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
聖誕節期間我都會在這裡，改變主意了就來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Um... You've played the game recently haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
嗯...你最近玩過這個遊戲吧？

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
You can try the game once a hour.
Please visit me after the one hour has passed.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
每小時只能玩一次。
等滿一小時再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Wow! You're so cool!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
哇！你真厲害！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Let me explain how to play this game.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
我來講講玩法。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
It's quite simple.
I will pick one of three cards: Poring Card, Ghostring Card, and Angeling Card.
Guess which card I pick and you're a winner!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
很簡單。
我會從三張卡片中選一張：波利卡片、幽靈波利卡片和天使波利卡片。
猜中我選的是哪張卡片，你就贏了！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
If you guess right 3 times out of 5, I will give you a gift.
Let's get started!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
如果你能在5次中猜對3次，我就給你一份禮物。
讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
First let me shuffle up these cards... Ok!!!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
讓我先洗牌... 好了！！！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
One!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
一！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Two!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
二！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Three!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
三！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I'm picking up only one!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
我只抽一張！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I'm picking up only one!
Please guess what is is.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
我只抽一張！
猜猜是哪張。

scripts.text: Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: Angeling
scripts.translation: 天使波利

scripts.text: Ghostring
scripts.translation: 幽靈波利

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...I choose Poring!

[{0}]
Um...I choose Angeling!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我選天使波利！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...I choose Ghostring!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我選幽靈波利！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Let's see!!
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
揭曉答案！！
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Let's see!!
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
揭曉答案！！
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
You're lucky.
Can you guess the right card the next time around?
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
你真幸運。
下一輪還能猜對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Aww maybe next time...
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
哎呀，下次再試吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is just luck.
Let me try again!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這全憑運氣嘛。
讓我再試一次！！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
隨時都可以。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
You're so good!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
你真棒！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Now this gift is for you.
Put your hand into the bag and pick only one.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
這是給你的禮物。
把手伸進袋子裡，只拿一樣。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Good job! Thanks for playing the card game with me!
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
做得好！謝謝你陪我玩紙牌遊戲！
聖誕快樂！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Do you mean that ever so fashionable costume for Santa's and youngsters!?!
Light-weight, fashionable, and keeps you warm!
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
你是說聖誕老人和年輕人都愛穿的時尚服裝嗎？！
輕便、時髦，還保暖！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
There used to be designer who visited my house to make my Santa costumes.
Do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
以前有位設計師來我家，幫我做聖誕服裝。
你有什麼想法嗎？

[聖誕老人]
...

[聖誕老人]
...
哦！可憐的男孩...

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
........................
Oh! Poor girl...
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
...
哦！可憐的女孩...

[聖誕老人]
...
哦！可憐的男孩...
...

[聖誕老人]
...
哦！可憐的女孩...
...

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
You should open your heart to the spirit of Christmas!
Once you do, I know you'll be able to think of something.
scripts.translation:
[聖誕老人]
敞開心扉，感受聖誕節的精神吧！
只要這樣，一定就能想到些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
I always thought about how boring Santa Claus is wearing a too boring costume.
Too boring!
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
我一直覺得，聖誕老人穿著那身毫無新意的衣服，實在太單調了。
太單調！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
I could make a glamorous style for him!
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
我能給他設計一個華麗的造型！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
I once made a costume for the notorious figure Antonio!
The reason catching up to him is so hard, is that his clothes have been given strong power!
I blessed them with good luck!
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
我曾給臭名昭著的安東尼奧做過一套服裝！
他那麼難追，就是因為我給衣服注入了強大的力量，還加上了好運的祝福！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Preta Porter!!
Which is quite luxurious but sold at good price ~
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
高階成衣！！
奢華又實惠~

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Hey loosers!
You can share my sense of fashion and wear my look if you run a light mission for me.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
嘿，土包子們！
幫我完成一個小任務，就能體驗我的時尚品味，穿上我設計的服裝。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
你們感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，請說

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Ah!
You're silly! You lost your big chance!
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
啊！
真傻！你錯過了大好機會！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Come to me later if you want to get the mission.
I, Louise Kim, am generous enough to accept you next time.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
想接任務了就回來找我吧。
我路易絲·金這麼大方，下次也會給你機會。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
You're so cool.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
你真酷。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Don't worry about this mission.
It's not that difficult.
I'm only in need of some materials. Things that are beyond my ability...
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
別擔心，任務不難。
我只是需要些材料，有些東西我自己實在弄不到...

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Anyway, can you bring me some stuff?
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
總之，你能幫我帶點東西來嗎？

scripts.text: Why not? What do you need?
scripts.translation: 沒問題，需要什麼

scripts.text: Sorry, no time.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，沒時間

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
What?
You will definitely regret it.
No more chances later.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
什麼？
你肯定會後悔的。
以後可沒機會了。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
All right, you're cool!!
You need to bring me: ^0000FFCotton Shirt, 3 Red Potion, Holy Water, 4 Wrapping Paper, Wrapping Lace^000000.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
好吧，你真酷！！
你需要給我帶：^0000FF棉襯衫、3個紅色藥水、聖水、4個包裝紙、緞帶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
If you bring me all that stuff, I can make you a glamorous Santa costume.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
如果你把這些東西都帶給我，我就能為你做一套華麗的聖誕老人服裝。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
If you were to bring me all the stuff, I would make you a wonderful costume, for free...
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
如果你把這些東西都帶給我，我會免費為你做一套很棒的服裝...

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Please see me again if you are interested.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
如果你有興趣，請再來找我。

scripts.text: Here you are.
scripts.translation: 給你

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Oh! Good!
Let's not delay.
I will show you my limitless ability.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
哦！好！別耽擱了。
讓你見識一下我無窮的本領。

scripts.text:
-She pours everything in a pot-
-even the shirt goes in!-
-She takes it out with skill-
-and many blessings she sings.-
scripts.translation:
-她把所有東西倒進鍋裡，連襯衫也放進去了！-
-接著熟練地取出襯衫，嘴裡唱著祝福的歌。-

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
By artist, Louise Kim!
All over the world will be blessed tonight!
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
有藝術家路易絲·金在！
今晚全世界都將得到祝福！

scripts.text:
-Pour red potion in another pot-
-then stir all of its parts.-
-Put the cotton shirts in-
-and dye it for grateful hearts.-
-Thread by thread-
-String by string-
-Count your blessings and sing!-
scripts.translation:
-把紅色藥水倒進另一口鍋，攪拌均勻。-
-放入棉襯衫，為感恩的心染上色彩。-
-一針一線，一絲一縷。-
-細數所得的祝福，唱起歌來！-

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
By artist, Louise Kim!
All over the world will be blessed tonight!
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
有藝術家路易絲·金在！
今晚全世界都將得到祝福！

scripts.text:
-She is knitting clothes-
-with a hooked needle-
-with her great skill.-
-Spread your blessings,-
-cheer and goodwill!-
scripts.translation:
-她憑著高超的技巧，用鉤針編織衣服。-
-傳遞祝福、歡樂和善意！-

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
This is miraculous!
I am a genius of the world.
Artist, Louise Kim!!!
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
這太神奇了！
我是世界級的天才。
藝術家，路易絲·金！！！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
All right! Isn't it wonderful?
You can call it what you wish.
My fashion is radiant.
I ain't envious of Designer Pierre.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
好了！是不是很棒？
隨你怎麼稱呼，它都一樣耀眼奪目。
我才不羨慕設計師皮埃爾呢。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
I am supposed to get paid well, however I will just let it be free, since this is Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
我本來應該收很多錢的，但既然是聖誕節，我就免費給你吧！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Go brag about these wonderful clothes. There wouldn't be any without me, Louise Kim.
scripts.translation:
[路易絲·金]
去炫耀這套漂亮衣服吧。
沒有我路易絲·金，可就沒有它！
